More effective use of AI hardware and better environmental monitoring are also within the realm of current technological possibility. Companies in the AI sector should provide detailed, relevant, and accurate information on their energy and water consumption. This information should be made available to the public to help governments and local communities evaluate the true impacts of AI infrastructure. [...] Artificial Intelligence may resolve global challenges. However, the field can only provide so much. A society's goals must determine the direction of human affairs and science. Eventually, societies must consider whether the costs for such goals are worth the outcome.
